chunks.P1-C1: This agreement is made between Mr. Ravi Kumar (the Landlord) and Ms. Anita Rao (the Tenant) for the flat at 12, Lake View Apartments.
chunks.P1-C2: 1. Rent. The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of Rs. 18,000 on or before the 5th day of every month.
chunks.P1-C3: 2. Security deposit. The Tenant has paid a refundable security deposit of Rs. 54,000. The Landlord may deduct reasonable charges from the deposit at the time of vacating, and the balance will be returned in due course.
chunks.P1-C4: 3. Lock-in period. The Tenant shall not vacate the flat during the first 6 months of the tenancy.
chunks.P1-C5: 4. Termination by Tenant. After the lock-in period, the Tenant may end this agreement by giving 2 months' written notice to the Landlord.
chunks.P1-C6: 5. Termination by Landlord. The Landlord may terminate this agreement at his sole discretion if he considers the Tenant's conduct unsuitable.
chunks.P1-C7: 6. Maintenance. The Tenant shall pay maintenance charges as decided by the Landlord from time to time.
chunks.P1-C8: 7. Late payment. If rent is not paid by the due date, a penalty may be levied on the Tenant.
chunks.P1-C9: 8. Subletting. The Tenant shall not sublet or share the flat with any other person without the written consent of the Landlord.
chunks.P1-C10: 9. Repairs. Minor repairs up to Rs. 1,000 shall be borne by the Tenant. Major repairs shall be borne by the Landlord.
